rig.sides: anatomical; left is on viewer's right in the rest pose
rig.coordinates: integer pixels in the shared 768x640 canvas
rig.composition: source-over by ascending z, place every layer at (0,0) in rest pose
rig.pivotApplication: rotate around each pivot in rest canvas coordinates; propagate parent transforms down the tree

core.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Independent 2D game skeletal sprite pieces on a completely transparent RGBA canvas. Use the attached female game character as exact visual identity reference. Keep the same chibi proportions, saturated color palette, large detailed eyes and facial features, costume fabrics, bold ink contours, fine cel shading, frontal slightly elevated 3/4 view. One standalone painted opaque part centered in each specified invisible cell, generous clear margins. Add short hidden overlaps for sewing the joints, no labels, no grid, no backdrops, no floating border, no shadow. Anatomical left is viewer right. Strict square 2x2 atlas. Row1 left: complete head in exact identity with broad amber eyes, warm brown front hair, no helmet, fine golden forehead chain and tiny red garnet; short hidden neck. Leave the long ponytail OFF the head (make it separate). Row1 right: one complete independent high chestnut ponytail that emerges from a golden tie at its root in the upper left, loops gracefully upward and hangs down to viewer right like the reference. Row2 left: upright sleeveless silver plate torso, subtle rose-gold ornament and hip faulds, fitted waist, closed drawn edges under shoulder. Row2 right: broad flowing crimson cape, dark interior, narrow at the neck and wider at lower edge.
